scientific_integrity.analytic_proof: Incidence-matrix Schur complement plus exhaustive six-class electrical-current count for arbitrary incident edge.
scientific_integrity.computational_support: Exact-rational independent reconstruction of all 357 edge columns of six finite Steiner designs and symbolic rational identities.
scientific_integrity.not_proved: Global novelty beyond investigated literature; independent mathematical validation; arbitrarily weighted variants; projection minimality.

scientific_limitations: Existing Steiner 2-(v,k,1) designs only; no claim for parameter sets without a design.
Canonical real Euclidean-orthogonal cut/cycle projections of unweighted point-block incidence graphs, not minimum projection constants.
No conclusions about weighted graphs or intermediate lp norms.
Potential equivalent results in less-indexed electrical-network or design-theory literature remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Universal endpoint norms for Steiner-design incidence graphs
